text:
adan: FYI running the new next-isr-agent starter (Next + LangChain agent flow) and seeing weird auth parity between browser SDK and server handler. client calls go through fine, but ISR revalidation path triggers repeated 403s then a success. billing shows multiple embed/eval attempts.

adan: repro: clone github.com/redwood/samples/next-isr-agent, yarn && vercel dev, open page, trigger agent query, wait for revalidate (edge/ISR) -> server logs show three 403 then 200. UI shows single result.

violet: can you paste the revalidation handler snippet? sometimes people use NEXT_PUBLIC keys for quick demo which causes the client to behave differently than the server.

adan: handler in /pages/api/revalidate.js:
```js
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference-js';
Redwood.init({ apiKey: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_REDWOOD_KEY });
export default async function handler(req) {
  const payload = JSON.parse(req.body);
  const out = await Redwood.call({ model: 'agent-1', input: payload.q });
  return new Response(JSON.stringify(out));
}
```

adan: i know lol NEXT_PUBLIC. but even after moving to server-only env var and bumping SDK, we still saw the 403-retry pattern but only on ISR revalidate endpoint, not on normal api routes.

rachel: interesting. which SDK version? and what runtime (edge/node)?

adan: using @redwood/inference-js 0.12.0 in the fork. running in node server runtime for ISR via Next dev. dev server prints: `AuthError 403 on token refresh`, `Retrying (1/3)`, `Retrying (2/3)` then success.

violet: there was a subtle bug in 0.12.0 where the token refresh helper attempted a background refresh using a cached fetch instance that didn't include the credential header when invoked from inside Next's revalidate flow. fixed in 0.12.2. also ISR can re-enter the handler multiple times if next dev retries on streaming failures.

adan: upgraded to 0.12.3 and replaced NEXT_PUBLIC var. retested: no more 403s in node dev, good. but on Vercel Edge previews using the Edge runtime the telemetry counts are zero for revalidate-originated calls. UI shows answer but Console telemetry shows 0 evals and 0 agent_calls.

rachel: are the edge preview logs showing outbound telemetry POSTs? sometimes the fetch polyfill in edge drops custom internal headers, and in revalidate context the request is treated as static generation vs normal request so telemetry hook is inactive.

adan: network tab in preview shows no telemetry POST. code uses `Redwood.telemetry.track('agent_call', {...})` right after call. that resolves but nothing sent. local node dev sends telemetry fine.

violet: is the starter initializing telemetry early? in edge you must call `Redwood.initTelemetry()` on module load for it to attach to the edge fetch wrapper. maybe the sample defers init to inside the handler which is too late for next runtime internals.

adan: aha our sample calls `Redwood.init()` inside handler. moving init to top-level module and bumping SDK fixed it locally in edge preview -> telemetry POSTs appear and Console counts increment.

build-bot: CI failure in integration/isr.test.js observed flakiness: revalidate path sometimes returns 502 when SDK init is deferred. Suggest adding test that runs the revalidate handler and asserts telemetry was emitted.

ops: note - duplicate token accounting during retries is still a problem. even with SDK fixes, any middleware or CDN retries that re-invoke the handler will cause duplicate billed attempts. infra ticket INGEST-411 raised to dedupe ingestion by request id when possible.

adan: action items we've done: 1) update sample to use server-only env var, 2) init Redwood at module top-level in edge handlers, 3) bump SDK to >=0.12.3 in template, 4) add a comment in README about ISR/revalidate semantics and telemetry caveats. opened PR 4021.

rachel: +1 for README note and adding a tiny runtime check that warns if telemetry queue is empty after a model call (dev-only). helps catch this during onboarding.

violet: also add a short unit test that simulates init-on-demand vs module-init to detect regressions in the future.

adan: PR opened and CI green after bump and tests. will ping when merged. thanks for the quick triage! :rocket:
